responsibility: Provides the crate’s built-in MIR dataflow analyses as a single public module surface, organizing and re-exporting analyses that track local borrowing/escaping references, coarse local initialization, backward liveness, and storage state/necessity. The module’s files work together to supply the standard local-focused analyses used by the rest of `rustc_mir_dataflow`: borrowed-local tracking feeds aliasing and storage decisions, initialization approximates which locals may hold values, liveness determines which values may still be observed, storage-liveness determines when backing storage must exist, and `mod.rs` integrates these implementations into the `impls` interface.
